subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — success criteria and timeline (Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — success criteria and timeline (Acme)

Hi Jordan — great to speak today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed plan for the POC so we can align on scope, success criteria, timeline, and owners. Attaching a draft POC schedule (poc-schedule.xlsx) and our security pack.

Summary of agreed scope and success criteria:
- Scope: Integrate Redwood hosted inference API with Acme's support ticket summarization flow for ~2M tokens/day test volume.
- Success criteria (shared):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for <512 token requests under expected traffic.
  - Cost: Token/unit cost projection within target we discussed (estimate in attachment).
  - Quality: Reduction in average summary length by 25% while preserving key action items (evaluated via sample prompt set).
  - Reliability: No functional regressions over 2-week stability window; error rate < 0.5%.

Evaluation plan and ownership:
- Data & test set: Acme to provide a 500-example evaluation set (de-identified) and one staging API key for integration testing. (Owner: Jordan / Priya)
- Technical integration: Redwood to provide example SDKs, a small model config tuned for latency, and a logging hook. (Owner: Rachel Kim, Redwood)
- Quality evaluation: Use shared prompt set + rubric we discussed; weekly spot-checks and final readout scoring. (Owner: Marissa Cole + Acme PD lead)

Proposed timeline (kickoff => final readout):
- Week 0: Kickoff meeting, environment access, and dataset delivery (target kickoff: week of Aug 3)
- Week 1-3: Integration + weekly check-ins (Tuesdays, 30m)
- Week 4: Final readout & scoring, decision / next steps

Next actions (owners & dates):
1) Acme: Share de-identified eval set and security contact (by Jul 22) — Jordan/Priya
2) Redwood: Share POC schedule XLS + security pack (sent) and create calendar invites (by Jul 17) — Marissa/Rachel
3) Schedule kickoff: Proposed Aug 3 or Aug 4 (confirm availability) — all

Attachments: poc-schedule.xlsx, redwood-security-pack.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we confirm kickoff date.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>

Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>, Mark Hughes <mark.hughes@acme.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & weekly check-ins — success criteria and timeline (Acme)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications and notes from our side:

- Success criteria: Agrees on latency and quality targets; we'll add a secondary SLA around availability for our pilot (target 99.5% during test windows).
- Data: We'll aim to deliver the 500-example eval set by Jul 21. Note: we need guidance on acceptable de-identification fields — can Rachel share a short checklist?
- Security: We need your SOC2 summary and the current security questionnaire answers. The redwood-security-pack.pdf looks good; can you also send the completed vendor security questionnaire?
- Kickoff: Aug 3 works for us (morning PT). Proposed attendees from Acme: Jordan Ellis (PM), Priya Sharma (Data Lead), Mark Hughes (Eng Lead).

Next steps on our side:
1) Priya will assemble the eval set and reach out on SFTP access (by Jul 21).
2) I'll circulate an internal note to Eng to block Aug 3 morning.

If you can confirm Rachel as the technical lead for Redwood and share the data access instructions, we can lock the kickoff.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Product 
Acme Corp

- Technical owner: Rachel Kim will be the primary technical point for the integration and will manage our SDKs and sample configs. (Rachel: can you confirm capacity?)

Jordan / Priya / Mark — confirming kickoff Thursday, Aug 3 at 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite attached and join link will follow. Final checklist before kickoff:  

1) Acme: Deliver de-identified eval set + SFTP details (by Tue Jul 21) — Jordan / Priya
2) Acme: Completed vendor security questionnaire (or confirm questions outstanding) — Jordan
3) Redwood: Provide SDK repo link, data upload instructions, and test API key (by Aug 2) — Rachel

- 95p latency < 350ms; quality threshold: 25% reduction in length while preserving action items; stability error rate < 0.5%; availability target 99.5% during test windows.

If anything changes on your side, flag it here and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to kickoff — we’ll run through milestones and acceptance criteria in the first 30 minutes so everyone is aligned.
